title: F3 fix round 1: dispatch-thread tests deterministic — tests-green went red once on the merge of T-0241 (test_diff_unavailable_fails_closed KeyError T-0002)
spec:
STEP 0 (before any edit): the worktree must be on task/T-0241 (df9074f "Fix daemon posting of Codex dispatch results" in git log). If git log --oneline -1 does not show df9074f, run: git checkout -B task/T-0245 task/T-0241 (your branch name stays task/T-0245). Never rebase or drop df9074f.

Context: T-0241 changed orchestrator/daemon.py _dispatch_worker() to post done/failed bus results from executor.start()'s return, including a failed result when start raises, and added four tests to tests/test_daemon.py (test_dispatch_worker_posts_codex_done, _posts_codex_failed, _leaves_held, _exception_marks_failed). tests-green.sh passed three times in wt/T-0241 but the merge run went red once: ERROR test_diff_unavailable_fails_closed with a traceback ending KeyError 'T-0002' (bus.get raising for a task id that a previous test created), preceded on stderr by a RuntimeError boom traceback and a TypeError NoneType not subscriptable traceback from background threads. daemon.dispatch() runs _dispatch_worker through spawn_async (a daemon thread); after T-0241 that thread now writes to the bus (bus.post_result) on the failed and exception paths, so a thread leaked from one test can write into the bus of the next test on the shared module-level TMP.

Task: make the suite deterministic.
1. Find the exact interleaving (run tests/test_daemon.py in a loop, 20 iterations, or add a small sleep in the thread to force it) and record it in your final message.
2. Fix it in tests/test_daemon.py first: the dispatch tests must not leak threads past their own test (swap daemon.spawn_async for a synchronous call in those tests, or join every spawned thread in tearDown); reuse the existing swap helper. Touch orchestrator/daemon.py only if the race has a production cause (for example _dispatch_worker raising inside the except branch when the task is gone, in which case guard it with a try/except that logs and returns); say in the final message whether daemon.py changed and why.
3. Keep every T-0241 test and assertion intact.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows df9074f (the T-0241 commit) below your commit
for i in 1..20: python -m pytest tests/test_daemon.py -q (or the repo's unittest runner) passes every iteration with no ERROR and no traceback printed from a background thread after a test ended
the four T-0241 tests still pass unchanged in intent
final message states the interleaving found and whether orchestrator/daemon.py was changed

result.summary: Codex (sol, thread 01a0ba81-83bb-7d72-9163-cb4b15c46711) committed fd2e078 on top of df9074f (T-0241) in wt/T-0245: tests/test_daemon.py only. Interleaving found: test cleanup restored executor.start and swapped the bus sandbox before the spawn_async dispatch thread finished; the late thread got None (TypeError), then posted into the next test's bus (KeyError T-0002). Fix: the test harness runs spawn_async synchronously, and the non-blocking test collects its threads and joins them in cleanup. orchestrator/daemon.py unchanged (test isolation, not a production race). Codex ran 20/20 daemon-suite iterations clean; Planner: tests-green.sh wt/T-0245 exited 0 and five more test_daemon runs passed (82 tests each). Result posted by hand (F3 not merged yet).
